field.label: Enable CARP Failover
field.help: For CARP high-availability pairs only. When checked, the service runs only while this firewall is CARP master. On a firewall without CARP, the service will not start if this is checked.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Select the interfaces that participate in mDNS forwarding. At least two interfaces must be selected.

field.label: Common Inbound Services
field.help: Select common DNS-SD services that may be received and forwarded by the bridge. These selections are combined with any custom services entered below. Leave both fields empty to allow all inbound services.

field.label: Custom Inbound Services
field.help: Enter additional DNS-SD service names, for example _matter or _hue. The ._tcp and .local suffixes are optional. Names are case-sensitive. Custom values are combined with the common services selected above. Leave both fields empty to allow all inbound services.

field.label: Disable IPv4
field.help: Disable mDNS forwarding for IPv4 traffic.

field.label: Disable IPv6
field.help: Disable mDNS forwarding for IPv6 traffic. IPv4 and IPv6 cannot both be disabled.
